notes.title: Small percentage of users experiencing problems starting a new game
notes.notes:
It has been brought to our attention that a small percentage of users (2% - 3% reported cases) cannot start a new game. The button press sound effect occurs but nothing happens after this. We're still looking into this, unfortunately we can't seem to recreate the issue on any of our machines. When we can find a solution to this we will make an announcement here.

Many thanks :)

notes.title: New fullscreen mode
notes.notes: Just a quick update regarding our fullscreen mode. We have now implemented this in the latest update. Sorry for the delay in this, originally we had this mode in the build but had trouble allowing the player to escape from fullscreen, so we had to take this out temporarily. It's now in and fully working. Thank you :)

notes.title: New updates
notes.notes:
Hi there,
We were alerted to a few select instances where using certain items in particular rooms caused the game to not do anything and resulting in the player having to close the game down and restart. We have fixed this and is now included in the newest update. :)

Whilst we were in there we have also fixed some typos, minor animation glitches and character positioning.

We have also added in a new physical save button feature as well. The game already auto-saves your progress every 10 seconds, but we thought you might like the reassurance that you can do it too :)

Many thanks!

notes.title: Auto-save feature
notes.notes:
Hi there,
Some customers are getting confused whether the game auto-saves.
To confirm - yes the game already auto-saves, this is mentioned in the opening screen but we will look into making this clearer as well. So to confirm you can just close the game window down and next time you go back into the game, you will see your previous game already there :)
